main_text.l: Et hoc facillimo negotio in fossoribus
qui in profundis terræ cavernis operan-
est, quæ ad sanguinis refrigerium, quod
qua propter per se valent vitam homini-
bus illis adimere, licèt non tam cito,
quàm cùm à malo Genio copiosius &
intrant. Sic vice versa aërem hominibus
novit, ut illo gravati vix spiritum ducere,
imo se ne quidem commovere valeant,

page.notes: Printed text is partly damaged by a dark stain near "premere"; some words are doubtful (e.g. "patefcat", "crodentes", "copiâ"), transcribed as printed. Left edge fragment of an adjacent page omitted. Catchword "qua" also appears at the foot.
